    PREP

Good to know

Before your first box.

The complete starter kit: one reusable court bottle, three refill tubes, and thirty single doses across PREP, RALLY, and RESET.

Rhythm uses the sessions you plan and log to estimate when supply will run low. It prepares thirty replacement doses and shows the contents, price, and date before payment. You can move, skip, or pause it.
